messages.subject: CPD webinar: Recent developments in private M&A warranties (4 Feb)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that our quarterly CPD webinar, 'Recent developments in private M&A warranties and indemnities', takes place on 4 February at 13:00 (1 CPD hour). Lunch provided for those attending in the boardroom. Please register via the L&D portal.

L&D Team
